text:
Priya: FYI — Marco forwarded a formal ask from AtlasLogix (large fintech) for a private on‑prem deploy behind their VPC. Sales wants feasibility + rough timeline this week so they can push contract. Key asks: air‑gapped option, HSM/KMS integration, monthly SLA, audited logs, and image signing. Can we triage?

Marco: their deadline is tight — they want pilot in 10 weeks, GA in 6 months. Budget is decent but they require cost predictability. Repeated asks: dedicated capacity, no egress, and SOC2 + internal audit evidence.

Evan: quick gut — doable but depends on infra packaging (airgap bundle), remote install scripts, and an ops runbook. Need to confirm: do they want Redwood-managed control plane in their VPC or fully airgapped control plane? That changes scope a lot.

Marco: they prefer control plane in their VPC (private deployment) with no egress to public internet. They also require optional on‑prem appliance later.

Lina: ML note — model weights need to be pre‑loaded and quantized; KV cache persistence across restarts will need a compatible local storage option. We'll need to test latency profiles on their infra.

Jae: security flags — HSM integration and KMS bring key exchange and attestation requirements. We'll need to validate network ACLs, propose a secure bootstrap flow, and get legal to sign the required Data Processing Addendum. Also: image signing + provenance + SBOM.

Priya: OK — let's capture dependencies and owners. Proposed checklist (initial):
- [ ] deployment mode confirmed (control-plane VPC vs fully airgapped) — owner: Marco
- [ ] network requirements + CIDR, firewall rules, peering/VPN design — owner: Evan
- [ ] HSM/KMS integration path (PKCS11 vs cloud KMS) + attestation flow — owner: Jae
- [ ] airgap bundle: images + offline installer + docs — owner: Evan
- [ ] image signing & SBOM process — owner: Jae
- [ ] ops runbook + backup/restore for KV cache and models — owner: Lina/Evan
- [ ] telemetry plan (what we accept back, opt‑in) — owner: Priya/Lina
- [ ] compliance pack (SOC2 artifacts, audit checklist) — owner: Marco/legal
- [ ] SLA and support routing for Dedicated/Private — owner: Priya/support

Evan: I'll start a network req template and ask for their infra contacts. Quick ask for AtlasLogix: we need their NAT/egress policy if control plane will be reachable from our ops team. If fully airgapped we need physical media transfer plan.

Marco: noted — I'll get them to fill network template and confirm whether their security team will allow a short maintenance window for remote troubleshooting (they likely will for pilot).

Lina: for model onboarding we need sample hardware profile (GPU type, memory, disk), and perf target (p50/p95 latency). We should also scope quantization options up front.

Jae: security asks — recommended bootstrap flow: ephemeral operator token + signed installer + HSM attestation. Example snippet for installer bootstrap we discussed:
```
# operator generates one-time bootstrap token
redwoodctl bootstrap --token=XXXX --target-api=https://local-control.internal
```
This avoids long-lived credentials in the bundle.

Priya: high‑level timeline (ballpark):
- Week 0–2: intake forms, network + security template, confirm deployment mode.
- Week 2–6: infra packaging (airgap bundle if needed), HSM integration design, legal/compliance kickoff.
- Week 6–10: pilot deploy + validation (ops runbook, model load tests, telemetry opt‑in).
- Week 10–24: iterate to GA, add SLA contract, performance tuning, rollout plan.
Estimate: pilot in ~8–10 weeks if we get rapid responses; GA in 4–6 months.

Priya: Risks: delayed legal signoff, customer infra procurement for HSM, incomplete infra details (blocks network setup), telemetry policy disagreements, and on‑prem hardware mismatch causing perf regressions.

Evan: question — do we treat this as R&D project (timeboxed) or chargeable SOW? I'd prefer SOW for on‑prem work. Ops will need commitment for on‑call for pilot.

Marco: Sales confirms they're open to SOW for integration + pilot support. They'll push for ring‑fenced engineering time in the contract.

Priya: Action items: Marco to collect filled network + infra template + their security checklist by EOW (owner: Marco). Evan & Jae to draft initial bootstrap + HSM integration doc by next Tue. Lina to draft model perf checklist and required hardware matrix by next Wed. I'll draft intake summary and tentative backlog ticket with acceptance criteria.

deploy-bot: New ticket created: PD-4827 AtlasLogix private intake — priority: high — assignees: Priya, Marco, Evan.

Marco: I'll loop in their infra lead (cc: @carmen-atlas) and legal contact after I get templates filled.

Priya: Good — we'll reconvene Tue sync if docs are ready. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
